name: @holoscript/agent-runtime
description: Provider-neutral second-brain runtime and contract helpers for human and agent operators.

scripts.build: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/memory-package.mjs && node --check src/agent-profiles.mjs && node --check src/sovereign-seed.mjs && node --check src/second-brain-runtime.mjs && node --check src/provider-planner.mjs && node --check src/frozen-provider-evaluation.mjs
scripts.check: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/memory-package.mjs && node --check src/agent-profiles.mjs && node --check src/sovereign-seed.mjs && node --check src/second-brain-runtime.mjs && node --check src/provider-planner.mjs && node --check src/frozen-provider-evaluation.mjs && node --test test/agent-runtime.test.mjs test/second-brain-runtime.test.mjs test/provider-planner.test.mjs test/frozen-provider-evaluation.test.mjs

publicConsumption.coreRule: Exports must be useful to a cold external agent with caller-supplied adapters; founder-local paths and secrets are adapter inputs, not package requirements.
publicConsumption.localAdapterBoundary: scripts/codex-session-start.mjs and repo hook configs are integration adapters outside the package contract.
publicConsumption.memoryPackage: @holoscript/memory is optional peer infrastructure; prefer public MEMORY_PG* env names and keep Holo-specific aliases backward-compatible.

holorepo.sourceTruth: Caller-provided Claude/Codex hook configs, memory path policy, GOLD intake, and store status probes.
holorepo.supportBoundary: v0-preview: shared hook IDs, hook config parsing, .env allow-list reads, optional @holoscript/memory and @holoscript/llm-provider bridges, executable bounded second-brain turns/loops, native provider-tool planning, sovereign seed prompts, and redacted runtime receipts are stable for public consumers with caller-supplied adapters.
holorepo.authBoundary: No secret values are emitted. Only allow-listed key presence and redacted readiness are returned.
